answer: Because the timing is published against the raven challenge, the dune audit can replay the kernel history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 61 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 146 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
